sig: [[["A", "Good morning, and welcome to Greenfield Electronics. I'm David, and I'll be your guide for today's tour of our main factory."], ["A", "This plant produces around five thousand circuit boards every day, which are shipped to customers in over thirty countries."], ["A", "The tour will take about an hour, and we'll start here in the assembly area."], ["A", "After that, we'll move on to the testing lab, and then we'll see the packaging department."], ["A", "Before we go in, please put on the safety glasses and the blue jackets you were given at reception."], ["A", "They help protect our products from dust and static electricity."], ["A", "Also, photography isn't permitted inside the testing lab, so please keep your phones in your pockets there."], ["A", "The machines are quite loud in the assembly area, so stay close to me if you want to hear my explanations."], ["A", "Trust me, you don't want to miss the robots."], ["A", "At the end of the tour, we'll head to the cafeteria for some refreshments, and I'll be happy to answer any questions."], ["A", "Alright, if everyone's ready, please follow me."]], {"A": "M-GB"}]
